global.title: Resgistration on site
global.type_data_to_search: Search: type in a participant id, name or nickname or a main application field text

get_registration_player.description: Find project applications at the registration desk by player name, nickname or character name. Changes nothing.

params.obj_name: Search string: player name, nickname, login or character name

set_registration_player.description: Mark the player as registered on site.

set_registration_player_money.description: Accept the player fee right at the registration desk: creates a payment under the current gamemaster's registration payment type and credits it to the application.

set_registration_eco_money.description: Mark that the player has paid the ecological deposit at the registration desk.

set_registration_comments.description: Save a registrar note on the application — for example about a deposit left or equipment handed out.
